// Fixture film for the hook tests: a pure function of time. Stored as film.js.txt so no test runner
// (Node 20's `node --test test/` loads every .js/.mjs/.cjs below test/) executes it; makeProject() in
// test/hooks.test.mjs copies it into each temp project as film/film.js.
export default {
  __film: true,
  factory: () => ({
    scenes: [
      {
        from: 0,
        to: 4,
        name: 'card',
        draw: (g, lt, c) => {
          g.fillStyle = '#F0EEE6';
          g.fillRect(0, 0, c.W * c.p, 40);
        },
      },
    ],
  }),
};
